```{r}
# prepare raster data

# get communities extent and reproject to raster crs
com.e <- ext(com) %>% project(com, ghs.raw)

# crop and reproject raster to communities crs
ghs.r <- ghs.raw %>%  # global raster
  crop(com.e) %>%       # crop to area of interest
  project(crs(com), method = "near")   # reproject

writeRaster(ghs.r, file.path(procdata, child_env$subdir, "04_ghs_age", "ghs_age.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

# raster values to years
ghs.r.y <- ghs.r
values(ghs.r.y) <- sapply(values(ghs.r.y), function(x) {
  matched_year <- ghs.dcr$year[ghs.dcr$val == x]
  if (length(matched_year) == 1) {
    return(matched_year)  # Return the year if a match is found
  } else {
    return(NA)  # Return NA if no match is found
  }
})

unique(values(ghs.r.y))
```

```{r}
# define different functions to extract weights

# mean year weighted by overlap
extract_wmean <- function(rastlayer, vectlayer){
  extracted <- terra::extract(rastlayer, vect(vectlayer), exact = TRUE, bind = TRUE, fun = mean) %>% 
    data.frame() %>%
    mutate(ghs_age = ceiling(ghs_age / 5) * 5)  # round to next highest step
  return(extracted)
} 

# overlap weighted max
extract_wmax <- function(rastlayer, vectlayer){
  extracted <- terra::extract(rastlayer, vect(vectlayer), exact = TRUE, bind = TRUE, fun = max) %>%
    data.frame()
  return(extracted)
} 

# simple max -> newest buildings
extract_max <- function(rastlayer, vectlayer){
  extracted <- terra::extract(rastlayer, vect(vectlayer), bind = TRUE, fun = max) %>%
    data.frame()
  return(extracted)
} 

# year with largest overlap (newer if ties between overlap fraction)
extract_ovlap <- function(rastlayer, vectlayer, id_col){
  extracted <- terra::extract(rastlayer, vect(vectlayer), exact = TRUE) %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    mutate(!!id_col := vectlayer[[id_col]][ID]) %>% 
    group_by(across(all_of(c(id_col, "ghs_age")))) %>%    # groups by year and block id for blocks that overlap several pixels with the same year
    summarise(fraction= sum(fraction), .groups = "drop") %>%
    #ungroup() %>%
    slice_max(by = all_of(id_col), order_by = fraction, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
    slice_max(by = all_of(id_col), order_by = ghs_age, with_ties = FALSE)
  return(extracted)
}
```

```{r}
# get dominant age on block_id by building volume
get_dominant_age_byvol <- function(df, label) {
  df %>%
    group_by(block_id, ghs_age) %>%
    summarise(volume = sum(volume), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(block_id) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = volume, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(block_id, ghs_age) %>%
    rename(!!label := ghs_age)
}

# or by area
get_dominant_age_byarea <- function(df, label) {
  df %>%
    group_by(block_id, ghs_age) %>%
    summarise(area = sum(area), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(block_id) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = area, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(block_id, ghs_age) %>%
    rename(!!label := ghs_age)
}

dfs <- c("max", "wmax", "wmean", "ovlap")

results.vol <- list()  # To store outputs
for (name in dfs) {
  df_name <- paste0("bld.", name)
  df <- get(df_name)

  # Check for block_id before running the function
  if (!"block_id" %in% colnames(df)) {
    warning(paste(df_name, "is missing 'block_id'. Skipping."))
    next
  }

  results.vol[[name]] <- get_dominant_age_byvol(df, name)
}

results.area <- list()  # To store outputs
for (name in dfs) {
  df_name <- paste0("bld.", name)
  df <- get(df_name)

  # Check for block_id before running the function
  if (!"block_id" %in% colnames(df)) {
    warning(paste(df_name, "is missing 'block_id'. Skipping."))
    next
  }

  results.area[[name]] <- get_dominant_age_byarea(df, name)
}

results.area.tibble <- imap(results.area, function(tbl, name) {
  col_to_rename <- setdiff(names(tbl), "block_id")

  if (length(col_to_rename) != 1) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", name, "- expected exactly one non-block_id column, found:", length(col_to_rename)))
    return(tbl)
  }

  rename(tbl, !!paste0(name, ".area") := all_of(col_to_rename))
})

results.vol <- reduce(results.vol, left_join, by = "block_id")
results.vol <- results.vol %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0(., ".volume"),
    .cols = -block_id
  )

results.area <- reduce(results.area, left_join, by = "block_id")
results.area <- results.area %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0(., ".area"),
    .cols = -block_id
  )

bks.years <- bks.years %>%
  left_join(results.area, by = "block_id") %>%
  left_join(results.vol, by = "block_id")

```

```{r}
# Replace values <= 1990 with 1990
bks.years <- bks.years %>%
  filter(if_any(c(wmean, wmax, max, ovlap), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  mutate(
    wmean = ifelse(wmean <= 1990, 1990, wmean),
    wmax  = ifelse(wmax  <= 1990, 1990, wmax),
    max  = ifelse(max  <= 1990, 1990, max),
    ovlap = ifelse(ovlap <= 1990, 1990, ovlap)
  )

bks.years <- bks.years %>%
  filter(if_all(ends_with(c(".volume", ".area")), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(
    ends_with(c(".volume", ".area")),
    ~ ifelse(. <= 1990, 1990, .)
  ))
```

```{r}
tolerance_confusion_matrix2 <- function(truth, prediction, tolerance = 5) {
  # Create a full table of truth vs prediction
  raw_cm <- table(Truth = truth, Prediction = prediction)
  
  # Get original row/column names before relabeling
  truth_labels <- as.character(rownames(raw_cm))
  pred_labels <- as.character(colnames(raw_cm))
  
  # Count features per truth label
  truth_counts <- rowSums(raw_cm)
  
  # Rename truth labels to include counts (n=)
  rownames(raw_cm) <- paste0(truth_labels, " (n=", truth_counts, ")")
  
  # Convert to matrix for processing
  cm_matrix <- as.matrix(raw_cm)
  
  # Calculate acceptable predictions within tolerance
  acceptable <- outer(
    as.numeric(truth_labels),
    as.numeric(pred_labels),
    function(x, y) abs(x - y) <= tolerance
  )
  
  acceptable_cm <- cm_matrix
  acceptable_cm[!acceptable] <- 0
  
  # Compute global stats
  correct <- sum(acceptable_cm)
  total <- sum(cm_matrix)
  accuracy <- correct / total
  
  # Compute per-truth accuracy (row-wise %)
  row_correct <- rowSums(acceptable_cm)
  row_total <- rowSums(cm_matrix)
  row_percent <- round(100 * row_correct / row_total, 1)
  
  # Append per-row % to rownames of tolerance matrix
  rownames(acceptable_cm) <- paste0(
    rownames(acceptable_cm),
    " | ", row_percent, "%"
  )
  
  list(
    tolerance_matrix = acceptable_cm,
    full_matrix = cm_matrix,
    accuracy_within_tolerance = accuracy,
    per_class_accuracy_percent = setNames(row_percent, truth_labels)
  )
}

bks.test <- bks.years %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

vars_to_check <- c("max", "wmean", "wmax", "ovlap", "ovlap.volume", "max.volume", "wmean.volume", "wmax.volume", "ovlap.area", "max.area", "wmean.area", "wmax.area")

test.values <- bks.test %>%
  filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(vars_to_check), ~ !is.na(.)))

  
results <- list()


for (var in vars_to_check) {
  res <- tolerance_confusion_matrix2(
    truth = test.values$year,
    prediction = test.values[[var]],
    tolerance = 5
  )
  results[[var]] <- res
}
print(results)
```

```{r}
# Select best approach for application on complete dataset 

# Initialize message
message1 <- ""

# Check if child_env$approach exists in the list of approaches
approaches_list <- names(results)

valid_approach <- exists("approach", envir = child_env) &&
                  !is.null(child_env$approach) &&
                  !is.na(child_env$approach) &&
                  child_env$approach %in% approaches_list

if (valid_approach) {
  
  approach <- child_env$approach
  message1 <- paste0(message1, "Using defined approach ...\n")
  
} else {
  
  message1 <- paste0(
    message1,
    "No valid approach given. Assigning the best approach based on accuracy...\n"
  )
  
  # Compute accuracies once (avoid repetition)
  accuracies <- sapply(results, function(x) x$accuracy_within_tolerance)
  
  max_accuracy <- max(accuracies)
  tied_approaches <- names(accuracies)[accuracies == max_accuracy]
  
  # Choose first if tie
  approach <- tied_approaches[1]
}

message1 <- paste0(message1, "> The selected approach is: ", approach, "\n")

cat(message1)

```

```{r}
# Now, based on the selected approach, apply the respective function

# get method and metric
method <- str_extract(approach, "^[^.]+")  # get first part of approach
metric <- str_extract(approach, "(?<=\\.).+$")  # get second part of approach

if (!is.na(metric)) {
  polylayer <- bld0
  
  extracted <- switch(
    method,
    wmax  = extract_wmax(ghs.r.y, polylayer),
    wmean = extract_wmean(ghs.r.y, polylayer),
    max   = extract_max(ghs.r.y, polylayer),
    ovlap = extract_ovlap(ghs.r.y, polylayer, "building_id"),
    stop("Selected method is not valid.")
  )
  
  extracted.export <- if (metric == "volume") {
    get_dominant_age_byvol(extracted)
  } else if (metric == "area") {
    get_dominant_age_byarea(extracted)
  }
  
} else {
  polylayer <- bks0
  
  extracted <- switch(
    method,
    wmax  = extract_wmax(ghs.r.y, polylayer),
    wmean = extract_wmean(ghs.r.y, polylayer),
    max   = extract_max(ghs.r.y, polylayer),
    ovlap = extract_ovlap(ghs.r.y, polylayer, "block_id"),
    stop("Selected method is not valid.")
  )
  
  extracted.export <- extracted
}


bks.export <- bks0 %>%
  left_join(
    extracted.export %>% select(block_id, year = ghs_age),
    by = "block_id")
```
